conviction_note: Scaled number = (2*55/100-1)*4.5 = +0.45. The FY26 beat is all but certain (9M ordinary already 95.7% of plan against this company's own 63-68% at the same point in FY24/FY25) but anyone can compute it, and this name sold its last two in-year beats (-0.45%, -1.13%). What the release ADDS is the first FY27 guide, on BOTH JGAAP and IFRS bases, and the dividend set off it at a 33% progressive payout. Those lean positive against a stock on ~13x the FY26 plan. The lean is held near 55 by a margin long that has been building (523.8k to 597.9k shares in three weeks, 98x 信用倍率, about 24 days of volume) and by the 40% PE holder. The findings sum to +0.90; the scaled number is half that. The sum carries the guide finding at full size, while p_up treats the sign as only a lean, because the bar is the company's own MTP and not an independent consensus.

findings.finding: The FY26 (Aug) results will clear the unrevised plan. 9M OP 1,031 / ordinary 992 / NP 590 are already 89.6% / 95.7% / 96.4% of plan. The implied Q4 is OP 119 / ordinary 45, against Q4 FY25 at OP 171 / ordinary 88 on a smaller group. My estimate is FY OP ~1,240 (+8%) and ordinary ~1,180 (+14%). This ends a record of missing the initial plan two years running (FY24 ordinary 763 vs 1,037; FY25 753 vs 975, -22.8%), neither of which was pre-revised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This year's in-period beats were not bought. Q2 (2026-04-14): H1 ordinary 673 against a 499 H1 forecast (+35%), next session -0.45%. Q3 (2026-07-14): 95.7% progress, next session -1.13%. Only the Q1 prints popped (+17.0% in Jan 2025, +10.0% in Jan 2026). Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/156A.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the progress rate is computable from the Q3 短信, and kabutan headlined it ('3Q累計経常が49％増益'). What may not be priced is credibility. The stock sits at ~13x a plan the company missed in each of the last two years, so delivering above plan for once is the residual. If the market fully trusted the plan, the PER would not sit below the MTP growth rate.
findings.independence: IFIS progress table (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=156A) shows the same numbers; one underlying document.

findings.finding: The FY27 guide is the first under the dual basis the company committed to on 2026-07-14: JGAAP and IFRS forecasts side by side. Under IFRS the ~175M of annual goodwill amortisation (the company's own FY26 figure) disappears. On the MTP path (OP 11.5 to 21.7億 by FY28, CAGR ~37%) that puts FY27 at roughly JGAAP OP ~15.5-16億 and IFRS OP ~17.5億, which is EPS of ~95 (JGAAP) or ~110 (IFRS) against a 865 spot, or 8-9x.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last new-year guide (2025-10-14): a +37.7% ordinary guide plus the MTP, alongside a 22.8% FY25 miss. The stock fell -2.68% the next session and kept falling (-3.87%, -3.51%). The year before (2024-10-11), a miss plus the FY25 guide gave -5.25%. Both prior guide prints were negative, but both carried a miss this one will not.
findings.why_not_priced: The MTP and the IFRS switch are public, but the price does not reflect the MTP path. At 865 the stock is ~13x the FY26 plan and ~9x the MTP-implied FY27 JGAAP EPS, which is what a market that discounts this management's targets after two missed plans looks like. A guide that confirms the MTP path, issued after a year that beat plan, plus an IFRS headline ~10-15% above the JGAAP one, is the information that would close that gap. The risk is a guide below the MTP path: Q3 materials flag PRP supply constraints and slower H2 gross-profit growth (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593298.pdf). That risk is the reason for the wide low end.
findings.independence: MTP targets: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014573138.pdf (a different document, Oct 2025). The 175M goodwill figure is from the Q3 presentation, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593298.pdf. Holders on the Yahoo board expect the IFRS optics to help (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/156A.T/forum, posts 2682-2685, 2026-09-04), which says retail partly anticipates it.

findings.finding: Dividend policy is a 33% payout with a progressive commitment (原則として減配せず). If the FY27 dividend forecast is set off MTP-path EPS of ~95-110, it comes out at ~31-36 yen against 26.1 for FY26, a yield of 3.6-4.2% at 865 against 3.0% now. FY26's 26.1 yen is already above 33% of the likely ~74 EPS, so no FY26 raise should be expected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividends have never been raised at a print beyond the plan (25.06, 26.00, 26.10). Buybacks were announced off-cycle and moved the stock sharply (2025-04-18 +7.63%; 2025-11-19 '大幅高'), per kabutan news https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=156A&nmode=0&date=20251100. So this register responds to capital-return news.
findings.why_not_priced: The current 3.0% yield prices the 26.1 yen, not a 30-yen-plus FY27 forecast. Retail on the board expects 増配 (post 2679 cites a 四季報 増配 forecast; post 2694 names 32 yen as the bar for 1,000 yen), so part of this is anticipated. It rests on the same guide as the previous finding and is sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Shares the EPS guide with the guidance finding (same underlying fact), so they are not independent. The payout policy itself is also in the MTP document, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014573138.pdf p.50-51.

findings.finding: Margin long balance built steadily into the print: 523.8k shares (09/18), 540.4k (09/25), 568.1k (10/02), 597.9k (10/09). That is ~6% of shares and ~24 days of volume, against 6.1k margin short (ratio 98) and zero disclosed institutional shorts. Leveraged retail is crowded long and has to sell eventually.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measured for this name. The last two prints with visible beats (Apr, Jul 2026) closed down the next session, which is consistent with long holders selling into the event.
findings.why_not_priced: The level is in the baseline lean (margin_overhang -1.0). The trend, +74k shares in three weeks, is not. A long crowd added at 850-875 means any disappointment in the guide has ready sellers, and even a good release can be sold for 出尽くし.
findings.independence: Baseline positioning.margin_ratio 98.02 agrees; same underlying scrape.

findings.finding: Advantage Partners funds still hold 40.47% after selling 4% to management at 851 yen in March 2026. A PE holder this large is a standing supply overhang, and a 売出し after full-year results is a common exit path, though nothing announced points to one inside this window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No secondary offering has occurred since IPO, per the kabutan news archive.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced as a discount since IPO. Only the tail case of an offering announced with or right after the results is unpriced, and it is speculative, hence the small central size with a wide low end. What the money buys: nothing for the company. It is a holder exit, so the sign is negative if it happens. Management buying at 851 with company loans signals alignment rather than a near-term sale.
